label: 3. All work and no play make the Commander a dull…

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: All work and no play make the Commander a dull boy!

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Time for a surprise round of Would You Rather?

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Take off my converter, or spend 10 years in the Rehabilitation Center.
Option 1, of course.
Option 1 would be irresponsible of me, so option 2.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Haha

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: That's my preferred option as well.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: If you had to choose, being destroyed mentally beats being destroyed physically any day of the week.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: No kidding! ㅇvㅇ

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: No offense Instructor but you wouldn't last a day in the center.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: You'd be wearing your underwear for a hat before it was time for chow.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: You'd really rather subject yourself to all that rather than remove my converter?

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: I didn't realize you had such strong convictions.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: All right, next question.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Take off my converter, or be sent to the surface for 20 years.
Option 1.
Option 2, because it's bound to happen sooner or later.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Looool

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Option 1 is always the way to go.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: If you chose option 2, you'd be trapped above ground for the rest of your life.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Having to spend every day hanging on by a thread... you can hardly call that life.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Whaaaa?!?!

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Why are you so pessimistic, Instructor?

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: How can someone responsible for countless Nikkes' mental health

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: be such a downer?

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: That's it, 15 points deducted!

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: That'll teach you to be more positive.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: All right, last question.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Take off my converter, or become Syuen's toady for life.
Option 1.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: You don't even want to think it over?
No. Option 1.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Haha!

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: I see!

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Choose option 2, and you'd be an underling, but at least you'd be working for the CEO of Missilis.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: That's bound to come with some perks attached.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: I'm surprised you picked the first option without any hesitation.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Then again, I suppose taking off my converter would be preferable

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: to spending the rest of your days under someone's thumb.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: After all, it's just a silly little mask all! Hehe!

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Anyway, Instructor((((((>▣<))))))

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: I hope you've learned something today.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Have a nice day!

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: XOXO
